title: MAP Sensor Low Voltage
fullDescription: Aprilia ECU detects MAP signal below limit. Common on RSV4 and Tuono.

title: Coolant Temp Sensor Low
fullDescription: Aprilia detects ECT short circuit. Cold-start strategy default.

fixSteps.title: Replace ECT
fixSteps.instruction: Drain coolant slightly, install new ECT.

title: Lambda Sensor Bank 1 Malfunction
shortDescription: Front bank O2 sensor not switching.
fullDescription: Aprilia closed-loop lambda not responding properly on bank 1.

title: Cylinder 1 Injector Circuit
fullDescription: Aprilia ECM cannot drive cyl 1 injector.
whenToCallPro: If V4 rear cylinder access needed.

title: Crankshaft Position Sensor
fullDescription: Aprilia CKP signal lost; engine no-start.

fixSteps.title: Replace CKP
fixSteps.instruction: Install new sensor on engine case.

title: Cyl 1 Coil Primary
fullDescription: Aprilia detects cyl 1 coil primary fault.

title: EVAP Purge Valve
fullDescription: Aprilia US-spec EVAP purge valve circuit fault.

title: Vehicle Speed Sensor
fullDescription: Aprilia VSS signal missing; speedo and TC affected.

faq.a: Wheel sensors separate; if ABS warns, address there.

title: Immobilizer Communication
fullDescription: Aprilia immobilizer fails to authenticate key. Engine cranks but won't run.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair keys
fixSteps.instruction: Have dealer pair keys with Aprilia diagnostic tool.

faq.a: Dealer must program a new transponder.

title: Barometric Pressure Sensor Low
fullDescription: Aprilia ECU internal baro sensor reading too low. Affects altitude compensation.

fixSteps.title: Software update
fixSteps.instruction: Apply Aprilia ECU update at dealer.

faq.a: Rare; usually resolved by ECU update.
